misc.title: Oda with his voice in 2003🥰🥰: When I come up with a story for One Piece, what usually comes to me first is a key scene showing how it will all play out in the end. Once I can see that climactic mome
misc.text: Oda with his voice in 2003🥰🥰: When I come up with a story for One Piece, what usually comes to me first is a key scene showing how it will all play out in the end. Once I can see that climactic moment clearly, I feel reassured, because I know I can make that part work. So even if audience tell me the story isn’t very interesting in the middle, it doesn’t scare me at all. I’m thinking, “Just wait until you see the ending!!🔥” Video
